description: This file defines the internal, immutable, read-only collection class 'RingRangeCollection' used for managing sorted, non-overlapping ranges of 'RingRange' objects within the Orleans runtime's grain directory component. It includes methods for creation, containment checks, intersection, difference, and enumeration of ranges, along with internal validation and debugging assertions.

classes.name: RingRangeCollection
classes.description: An internal, immutable, sorted collection of non-overlapping 'RingRange' objects, providing methods for creation, containment, intersection, difference, and enumeration.

methods.name: RingRangeCollection
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection with a sorted, non-overlapping array of 'RingRange' objects, with debug assertions to verify invariants.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a 'RingRangeCollection' from any collection of 'RingRange' objects, filtering out empty ranges and sorting them.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given 'GrainId' or uint value is within any of the ranges.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Determines if a 'RingRange' or another 'RingRangeCollection' intersects with the current collection.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Computes the difference between the current collection and a previous 'RingRangeCollection', returning a new collection.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the ranges.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the ranges.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the collection.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Formats the collection into a span of characters for display.
